16868-adventures-of-a-despatch-rider.title: A Despatch Rider
16868-adventures-of-a-despatch-rider.creator: Unknown
16868-adventures-of-a-despatch-rider.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. We have not even had time to talk it over properly. I saw you on my week's leave in December, but then I had not thought of making a book. Finally, after three months in the trenches you came home in August. I was in Ireland and you in Scotland, so we met at Warrington just after midnight and proceeded to staggering adventures.

arxiv-2207-08914.title: Conditional DETR V2: Efficient Detection Transformer with Box Queries
arxiv-2207-08914.creator: Xiaokang Chen, Fangyun Wei, Gang Zeng, Jingdong Wang
arxiv-2207-08914.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xiaokang Chen, Fangyun Wei, Gang Zeng, Jingdong Wang. In this paper, we are interested in Detection Transformer (DETR), an end-to-end object detection approach based on a transformer encoder-decoder architecture without hand-crafted postprocessing, such as NMS.

arxiv-2209-10557.title: Symmetry indicators in commensurate magnetic flux
arxiv-2209-10557.creator: Yuan Fang, Jennifer Cano
arxiv-2209-10557.description: Abstract We derive a framework to apply topological quantum chemistry in systems subject to magnetic flux. We start by deriving the action of spatial symmetry operators in a uniform magnetic field, which extends Zak’s magnetic translation groups to all crystal symmetry groups. Ultimately, the magnetic symmetries form a projective representation of the crystal symmetry group.

arxiv-2306-07216.title: Cyclic objects from surfaces
arxiv-2306-07216.creator: Ivan Bartulović
arxiv-2306-07216.description: Abstract . In this paper, we endow the family of closed oriented genus g g surfaces, starting with torus, with a structure of a (co)cyclic object in the category of 3 3 -dimensional cobordisms. As a corollary, any 3 3 -dimensional TQFT induces a (co)cyclic module, which we compute algebraically for the Reshetikhin-Turaev TQFT. Keywords .

arxiv-2311-03168.title: Euclid preparation
arxiv-2311-03168.creator: Euclid Collaboration: G. Jelic-Cizmek 1, F. Sorrenti 1, F. Lepori 2, C. Bonvin 1, S. Camera 3,4,5, F. J. Castander 6,7, R. Durrer 1, P. Fosalba 7,8, M. Kunz 1, L. Lombriser 1, I. Tutusaus 9,1, C. Viglione 7,6, Z. Sakr 10,9,11, N. Aghanim 12, A. Amara 13, S. Andreon 14, M. Baldi 15,16,17, S. Bardelli
arxiv-2311-03168.description: Abstract In this paper we investigate the impact of lensing magnification on the analysis of Euclid ’s spectroscopic survey, using the multipoles of the 2-point correlation function for galaxy clustering. We determine the impact of lensing magnification on cosmological constraints, and the expected shift in the best-fit parameters if magnification is ignored.

arxiv-2401-00428.title: Training toward significance with the decorrelated event classifier transformer neural network
arxiv-2401-00428.creator: Jaebak Kim
arxiv-2401-00428.description: Abstract Experimental particle physics uses machine learning for many tasks, where one application is to classify signal and background events. This classification can be used to bin an analysis region to enhance the expected significance for a mass resonance search. In natural language processing, one of the leading neural network architectures is the transformer.

arxiv-2505-13472.title: Proof Assistants for Teaching: a Survey
arxiv-2505-13472.creator: Frédéric Tran Minh, Laure Gonnord, Julien Narboux
arxiv-2505-13472.description: Abstract In parallel to the ever-growing usage of mechanized proofs in diverse areas of mathematics and computer science, proof assistants are used more and more for education. This paper surveys previous work related to the use of proof assistants for (mostly undergraduate) teaching.

arxiv-2509-09897.title: Gluon splitting rates in an anisotropic plasma in the AMY formalism
arxiv-2509-09897.creator: Florian Lindenbauer
arxiv-2509-09897.description: Abstract We introduce a novel numerical method to obtain the gluon splitting rates in an anisotropic QCD plasma in the AMY formalism, suitable for an anisotropic collision kernel. The method extends previous works by decomposing the additional angular information into Fourier modes, resulting in a significantly larger system of differential equations to solve numerically.

arxiv-2510-17618.title: Bergman metrics induced by the ball
arxiv-2510-17618.creator: Matteo Palmieri
arxiv-2510-17618.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Matteo Palmieri. We investigate when the Bergman metric of a bounded domain is, up to a constant factor λ \lambda , induced by the Bergman metric of a finite-dimensional unit ball 𝔹 N \mathbb{B}^{N} via a holomorphic isometric immersion. For a strictly pseudoconvex domain in ℂ 2 \mathbb{C}^{2} we prove rigidity: if such an immersion extends smoothly and transversally past the boundary and ( N + 1 ) / λ − 3 ∈ ℕ (N+1)/\lambda-3\in\mathbb{N} , then the domain is biholomorphic to the ball.

pmc-10652459.title: Exposing additional authors who suppress evidence about radiation-induced thyroid cancer in children: a Comment adding to Tsuda et al.’s response to Schüz et al. (2023)
pmc-10652459.creator: Colin L Soskolne
pmc-10652459.description: BackgroundThe need to call out and expose authors for their persistence in improperly using epidemiology has been previously noted. Tsuda et al. have done well to expose Schüz et al.’s arguments/assertions in their recent publication in Environmental Heath. In this Comment, I point out that, also warranting being called out, are the arguments/assertions of Cléro et al.

pmc-12468137.title: Endometriosis and Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-12468137.creator: Sabrina Compton, Rodolf Alkabalan, Judd Cadet, Azin Mastali, Prakash V. A. K. Ramdass
pmc-12468137.description: Background/Objectives: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) and endometriosis are debilitating conditions that share overlapping features of chronic inflammation and immune dysregulation, yet their epidemiological relationship remains poorly characterized. The objective of this study was to investigate the association between ME/CFS and endometriosis, examining shared risk factors, clinical correlates, and epidemiological patterns. Methods: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis.

pmc-12651030.title: TNFR1 Suppression by XPro1595 Reduces Peripheral Neuropathies Associated with Perineural Invasion in Female Mice
pmc-12651030.creator: Morgan Zhang, Naijiang Liu, Kesava Asam, Charles Meng, Bradley Aouizerat, Yi Ye
pmc-12651030.description: Highlights What are the main findings? In a mouse model of perineural invasion, blocking soluble TNFα signaling with XPro1595—but not TNFR1 knockout—reduced tumor burden, mechanical allodynia, and locomotor deficits, primarily in females.XPro1595 may exert its beneficial effects via promoting mitochondrial function and myelination while suppressing inflammatory, extracellular matrix, and tumor progression pathways. What is the implication of the main finding?

pmc-12666551.title: A secreted Leishmania metalloprotease manipulates host iron regulation by targeting the DICER1–miRNA pathway
pmc-12666551.creator: Suman Samanta, Sourav Banerjee, Rupak Datta
pmc-12666551.description: Micronutrient sequestration is a powerful host defense mechanism against intracellular pathogens. A key player in this is Nramp1, which effluxes iron from phagolysosomes thereby depriving the engulfed pathogens of this essential element. Leishmania major counters this by triggering hepcidin-mediated proteasomal degradation of Nramp1. Interestingly, L.

pmc-13212751.title: Real-time deep learning interpretation of echocardiographic video for automated detection of anatomical features associated with tetralogy of fallot in pediatric patients : a feasibility study
pmc-13212751.creator: Mi Jin Kim, Jeong Jin Yu, Seulgi Cha, Jae Suk Baek, Dongha Yang, Yeon Jin Jang
pmc-13212751.description: Tetralogy of Fallot (TOF) is a complex congenital heart defect requiring precise diagnosis. Echocardiography is essential for detection, but a global shortage of pediatric cardiologists can hinder timely diagnosis. Our study aims to develop an Artificial intelligence (AI) model using deep learning to automate TOF diagnosis from echocardiograms, serving as a screening tool in regions lacking specialists.

pmc-13234184.title: Exact solutions of nonlinear thermodynamic wave patterns in graphene sheets for advanced material applications
pmc-13234184.creator: Muhammad Abdaal Bin Iqbal, Muhammad Zubair Raza, Yakup Yildirim, Jalil Manafian, Hadi Rezazadeh, Younis A Sabawi
pmc-13234184.description: Graphene has emerged as a highly attractive nanomaterial, characterized by its distinctive thermodynamic, electrical, and mechanical features. These attributes render it ideal for a wide array of purposes across materials research, storing energy, computing, filtering water, and medication. In this study, we investigate the nonlinear thermophoretic wrinkle motion equation describing wave propagation and thermal-driven deformation in graphene sheets.

pmc-13367855.title: MXene (Ti3C2Tx) mediated multiscale electrolyte regulation enables robust interphase for dendrite-free solid-state sodium metal batteries
pmc-13367855.creator: Linfeng Zhao, Chenyi Cao, Tianxiao He, Penghui Cui, Kecheng Pan, Manman Wu, Bin Tang, Yong-Zheng Fang, Zhen Zhou
pmc-13367855.description: Solid-state sodium metal batteries (SSMBs) have garnered significant attention for next-generation high-safety energy storage, but their practical application is severely hindered by sluggish ion transport kinetics in solid electrolytes and the unstable sodium metal/electrolyte interface. Herein, we employ Ti3C2Tx MXene with abundant surface polar terminations as a multiscale regulator to construct composite solid electrolytes (P-OGN@NZSP/MXene).

pmc-13372404.title: Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing versus Deep Septal Pacing in Patients After Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement
pmc-13372404.creator: Liangzhen Qu, Xueting Duan, Han Chen
pmc-13372404.description: BackgroundLeft bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP) has been reported to improve long‐term clinical outcomes in patients requiring permanent pacemaker implantation (PPMI) after transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR). Deep septal pacing (DSP) has emerged as a potential alternative to LBBAP.ObjectiveThis study investigated whether short‐term and long‐term clinical outcomes differ between LBBAP and DSP in post‐TAVR patients.

pmc-13375522.title: Toward a gut-AMPK axis: the microbiome and AMPK signaling in nutrition and healthy aging
pmc-13375522.creator: Erik Dassoff, Hashim Islam, Jacob Allen
pmc-13375522.description: Modern nutrition research has evolved from early discoveries of essential vitamins to exploring the complex interactions between a much larger range of food-derived compounds (the foodome). The microbiome is a key link between diet and health outcomes through multiple gut-host axes. However, the field lacks a unifying framework to demystify its inherent complexities.

pmc-13627719.title: A dual-host regulatory hub integrating biofilm formation and innate immunity resistance
pmc-13627719.creator: Alexandre Baillez, Amélie Dewitte, François Pierre, Mounia Kortebi, Virginia S. Lioy, Mélanie Hillion, Julie Hardouin, Sébastien Janel, Xavier Thuru, Charlotte Clarisse, Hassiba Bouafia, Catherine Robbe Masselot, Sébastien Bontemps-Gallo, Florent Sebbane
pmc-13627719.description: Vector-borne pathogens must adapt to sharply distinct host environments, yet the regulatory logic that coordinates transitions between opposing host-specific programs remains poorly defined. Here, we identify a minimal regulatory module in the flea-borne pathogen Yersinia pestis that integrates vector transmission with resistance to mammalian innate immunity.
